run.name: Smoke tests with a security scan

bugs.title: content-security-policy is not set
bugs.classification: Security finding · Low confidence · new in this scan
bugs.summary: The response carries no content-security-policy header, which limits where scripts may come from. (CWE-1021 · A05:2021)
bugs.expected: The application is not open to missingsecurityheader.
bugs.actual: A browser applies its own defaults, which are more permissive than an explicit policy.
bugs.verifyTheFix: Run the security scan again (Testing → Run with security, or Security → SCAN-20261015-9D1493). The finding is marked resolved once a scan no longer observes it.
